name: degoog_extentions
description: Personal degoog extensions: engines, plugins and tools.
author: AromaticTurtle

plugins.name: Books (Hardcover)
plugins.description: Book panel in the side column from Hardcover: cover, authors, series, Hardcover rating and readers, genres, pages, description. Needs a free Hardcover API token (create it with only the read:catalog permission). Cached and capped to a daily request limit.

plugins.name: Board games (BoardGameGeek)
plugins.description: Board game panel in the side column from BoardGameGeek data: rating, rank, weight, players, playing time, designers, mechanics. Three optional sources with an automatic fallback: the BGG XML API (token, registration required), recommend.games (no key) and BGG's own website API (opt-in, off by default). Cached and capped by per-source daily limits.

plugins.name: Calculator
plugins.description: Calculator and unit converter card: arithmetic with exact big integers, percentages, functions, number bases and common units. Runs on your server, no upstream. Inline (detailed, above the results) or panel (compact, side column). Replaces the official math plugin.

plugins.name: Currency converter
plugins.description: Currency conversion card (usd to euro, 1 usd to pound, 5 quid in dollars, usd eur, 20 bucks to yen): fiat rates from open.er-api.com (one cached request a day, cross rates computed locally) and crypto prices from Coinbase's public API, with 24 h change and range. Inline (detailed) or panel (compact). No keys.

plugins.name: Dictionary
plugins.description: Dictionary card for define X, X meaning, synonyms of X, how to pronounce X and (optionally, on by default) a word typed on its own, from the Free Dictionary API (English, Wiktionary CC BY-SA): meanings, examples, synonyms and pronunciation audio. Inline (detailed) or panel (compact). Replaces the official define plugin.

plugins.name: Game info (IGDB + ProtonDB)
plugins.description: Video game panel in the side column: IGDB scores, platforms, developer, time to beat, ProtonDB Linux compatibility and a Steam link. Needs free Twitch/IGDB credentials. Cached. When a title is also a board game, shows whichever came first (configurable).

plugins.name: Reddit lens
plugins.description: Turns 'best homelab os reddit', 'reddit best homelab os', '!reddit ...' and 'r/homelab ...' into a site:reddit.com search, so your normal web engines return Reddit pages with their own titles, snippets and dates. Makes no request itself.

plugins.name: Stocks (Finnhub)
plugins.description: Stock quote card for 'AAPL stock', '$AAPL', 'apple stock price' and (optionally) a bare ticker: price, change, market status, day and 52-week ranges, statistics, sparkline when available. Needs a free Finnhub API key (US stocks on the free plan); sent only in a header. Inline (detailed) or panel (compact).

plugins.name: Weather
plugins.description: Weather card for 'weather in Paris', 'forecast', 'is it raining in Seattle': current conditions, 24-hour strip, 7-day forecast, air quality, from Open-Meteo (no key). Disambiguates 'paris texas'. A bare 'weather' asks the browser to use your location (or a typed city) and remembers it in that browser. Inline (detailed) or panel (compact). Replaces the official weather plugin.

plugins.name: Sports scores (ESPN)
plugins.description: Live score card for 'panthers score', 'did the lakers win', 'arsenal match', 'nfl scores': NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Premier League, WNBA and NCAA football/basketball from ESPN's public (unofficial, keyless) scoreboard. Never answers a bare team name. Inline (detailed) or panel (compact), refreshes while a game is live.

engines.name: Marginalia
engines.description: Marginalia Search (small, non-commercial web) through its API. Needs a free API key. One request per page, spaced out, with a cool-down after rate limiting.

engines.name: Mojeek
engines.description: Mojeek web search without an API key. Passes Mojeek's small proof-of-work check once a month, then each search is one request. Bounded, paused after blocks.

engines.name: Reddit Search
engines.description: Reddit posts from Reddit's public Atom search feed with relevance sort, subreddit, date, a real excerpt and a thumbnail, instead of the official engine's thin results. One request per page, cached, paused (never bypassed) when Reddit refuses.

engines.name: Mwmbl
engines.description: Mwmbl, the non-profit community search engine, on the web tab. Works without a key. One request per search; later pages come from a 10 minute cache. Tidies Mwmbl's rough results.

engines.name: OpenAlex
engines.description: Scholarly works from OpenAlex on a Scholar tab. Works without a key; a free key raises the daily budget. Stops when the daily budget is spent.

engines.name: CORE
engines.description: Open access research papers from CORE on a Scholar tab. Needs a free API key. Paced to CORE's small quota.

engines.name: Unsplash
engines.description: Unsplash photos on the Images tab through the official API. Needs a free API key. Credits the photographer with their profile address.

engines.name: Pixabay
engines.description: Pixabay photos, illustrations and vectors on the Images tab through the official API. Needs a free API key. Results cached 24 hours as the terms ask, every result credited to its contributor.

engines.name: Openverse
engines.description: Openly licensed images (Creative Commons and public domain) on the Images tab through the official API. Works without a key; optional client credentials for higher limits. Shows licence and creator.

engines.name: Pexels
engines.description: Pexels photos on the Images tab through the official API. Needs a free API key. Hourly and monthly budgets, every result credited to its photographer.

engines.name: selfh.st
engines.description: Search the selfh.st self-hosted app directory on an Apps tab, including its alternative-to lists. Downloads the list once, caches it on disk and searches locally.

favicon.name: selfh.st icons
favicon.description: Real app logos from selfh.st/icons for self-hosted software sites (n8n.io, jellyfin.org and about 830 more). Unknown hosts fall through to the next provider. Drag it above Google in Settings, Favicons.
